byte_contract.projection: exact multiple-choice knapsack over physical wire bytes

training_contract.categorical_estimator: hard one-hot forward plus softmax minus detached softmax backward
training_contract.byte_constraint: scalar expected-byte dual during soft training; exact hard projection at every DEV checkpoint
training_contract.frozen_state_proof: runtime.frozen_state() tensor digest is recorded before and after training and must match

data_manifest_api.runtime_owned_row_fields: The runtime adapter may require token IDs, teacher-logit sidecars, or other predeclared immutable row fields.
invariants: declared class counts equal observed rows
all six classes have positive counts
TRAIN and DEV window IDs are disjoint
manifest hashes remain unchanged through training
any path containing HOLDOUT is rejected

attributes.cell_layers: ordered sequence mapping each cell to one of 43 layer IDs
attributes.layers: strictly ascending sequence of the 43 layer IDs
attributes.tier_bytes: integer tensor [22016,3] containing physical wire bytes

methods.batches(manifest): return ordered windows without reordering or introducing undeclared data
methods.layer_stage(layer): context manager that loads native/QTIP2/QTIP3 candidates only for this layer and yields a differentiable forward callable
methods.layer_forward_rule: gates have exact hard one-hot numerical values in forward and straight-through soft gradients; the selected physical tier branch must produce the forward activation
methods.final_logits(activation, window_id): return candidate final vocabulary logits as a torch tensor
methods.teacher_logits(batch): return frozen own-base final vocabulary logits for the same window
methods.frozen_state(): return an exhaustive non-empty name-to-tensor mapping covering router, teacher, all tier planes/codebooks/scales, and all non-gate model state

runtime_adapter_api_v1.lifecycle: One process owns ordered windows. The trainer enters layer_stage exactly once per layer per pass, advances every window through that layer, then releases the stage before the next layer.

outputs.RECEIPT.json: manifest identities, frozen-state digests, soft/hard KLD checkpoints, movement, entropy, raw gradient norms, expected/hard bytes, and relaxation gap
outputs.ASSIGNMENT.json: exact projected per-cell tier assignment and full-wire byte accounting
